crime_highlights: Wilson stood at the door with his bowie knife
Alvarez pulled his imitation gun out of his waistband, pointed it at the head of the male friend of A.B., threatened the other people in the room with it and then told them to get down
A.B. reluctantly obliged out of fear
Bingley demanded that A.B. give them $4000. A.B. took the money he had out of his wallet and gave it to Bingley.
rationale_highlights: I must also give due weight to Mr. Wilson's Aboriginal background
the circumstances of his upbringing through his childhood and his youth were terribly, terribly sad with there having been significant neglect, abuse, and physical violence
it cannot result in Mr. Wilson receiving precisely the same sentence of four years that was imposed on Alvarez
note: Crime paragraph is the long agreed statement of facts; cannot be shortened.

crime_highlights: She asked him to leave the residence
Mr. Ghostkeeper obtained a handgun that was discharged and a bullet went out the window
it is an aggravating factor that a firearm was discharged in a domestic setting
rationale_highlights: He has, I am told by counsel, suffered many of the problems that many First Nations people have suffered with regard to poverty, abuse, alcohol and drug addiction issues
Mr. Ghostkeeper has suffered many problems throughout his life and has generally, I am told, been doing quite well up until this point
note: Brief joint-submission ruling; court never states effect of Indigenous background.

crime_highlights: Mr. West sat next to Complainant Number 2 and tried to kiss her
She was able to get Mr. West off of her, but he refused to leave
Complainant Number 1 says that Mr. West was highly intoxicated
rationale_highlights: the unique systemic or background factors that may have played a part in bringing the particular offender before the court speaks to the moral blameworthiness of the offender
A fit sentence is one that is proportional and appropriately balances the seriousness of the offence with the moral blameworthiness of the offender
Mr. West has a reduced level of moral blameworthiness
He had a highly chaotic childhood in which substance abuse and sexual violence were normalized
note: Crime highlights avoid graphic sexual detail; offender history is in paras 13-14.
